title: Kissed Smoky Filipino Blackberries Pancakes
description: A lazy Sunday Filipino dish featuring blackberries and a smoky flavor, made with a tava griddle and nut-free friendly ingredients. This dish is perfect for a relaxing breakfast.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Gently fold in the blackberries and smoked paprika.
Heat a tava griddle over medium heat and brush with a small amount of oil.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the griddle.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes warm and enjoy.
